title: Deduplicate the 6 copies of _insertTrack() in story_acceptance tests onto the existing shared seedTrack() helper
why: Six of the seven files in this batch reimplement the identical 13-line _insertTrack() (insert a mishnayos curriculum_tracks row with DateTime.now() for stateChangedAt/activatedAt) instead of calling the shared seedTrack() already in test/helpers/drift_memory.dart:82-98 — which epic_13_cloud_sync_test.dart (the 7th file) uses correctly. seedTrack() itself uses the injectable DateTimeFactory.nowUtc() (a LocalDayClock-backed seam per lib/core/utils/date_utils.dart:8-18), while all 6 duplicates use a raw, unfakeable DateTime.now(), bypassing the seam the rest of the codebase standardizes on. Any future change to curriculum_tracks' required columns needs 7 edits instead of 1, and copies can silently diverge, as the clock call already has.
recommendation: Delete the 6 private _insertTrack() functions and call seedTrack(db, profileId: 1) from test/helpers/drift_memory.dart at each site, as epic_13_cloud_sync_test.dart already does.
acceptance_criteria: All 6 files call the shared seedTrack() helper instead.
